references.text: The Wilderness of Sin is also mentioned here as a place where the people of Israel stayed during their wilderness journey.
The Wilderness of Sin is described as the southern border of the promised land, the same area from which the spies explored.
Lebo-Hamath is mentioned as the northern border of the land of Canaan, the same place the spies reached.
Lebo-Hamath is referred to as the boundary of the land that had not yet been taken.
Rehob is mentioned as a place near Laish/Dan, in the northern part of the land explored by the spies.
Lebo-Hamath is mentioned as the northern border of Israel's territory during Solomon's time.
Lebo-Hamath is described as Israel's northern border that was restored under Jeroboam II.
Hamath is mentioned in Ezekiel's prophetic vision about the future borders of the land, corresponding to the borders explored by the spies.
Lebo-Hamath is mentioned as the northern border of the land in the prophecy against Israel.
